hero.title: Plant one idea. Grow content everywhere.
hero.subtitle: Strategy in. Content and publishing out.

problem.title: Most content tools are standalone. Your campaigns aren't.
problem.paragraph1: Digital marketing now demands a constant supply of content — for feeds, marketplaces, and inboxes at once. Doing it by hand doesn't scale, and the AI writers and image generators bolted onto every other tool only solve one piece.
problem.paragraph2: What's missing is the system around the content: a strategy that's defined once, a process that turns it into channel-ready output automatically, and a record of what actually performed. Mosonic is that system, built around how Thai SMEs and the agencies serving them actually work.

create.title: Generate everything

measure.title: See what worked

howItWorks.title: One strategy. Seven stages. Every stage is automatic after the first.
howItWorks.subtitle: Like a bamboo culm, Mosonic grows in fixed stages — each one building directly on the last, with nothing skipped and nothing left to chance.

strategy.label: Stage 01
strategy.title: Set the strategy
strategy.description: Define brand tone, target audience, goals, and channels once. Everything downstream inherits it.

template.label: Stage 02
template.title: Build the template
template.description: Choose which steps a piece of content goes through — write, illustrate, translate, animate — and reuse it for every future run.

run.label: Stage 03
run.title: Run it
run.description: Give Mosonic a prompt for this batch. It executes the template against your strategy in the background.

generate.label: Stage 04
generate.title: Generate content
generate.description: Copy, images, video, and translations come back versioned, so you can compare and pick a winner before anything goes out.

package.label: Stage 05
package.title: Package for each channel
package.description: Captions and media are reformatted per platform automatically — no manual resizing or rewriting for each feed.

publish.label: Stage 06
publish.title: Publish
publish.description: One action posts to every channel you've selected, on schedule, with no double handling.

track.label: Stage 07
track.title: Track results
track.description: Performance flows back per post and per channel, so the next run starts smarter than the last.
